event: Deprecated Slack verification token appeared in one browser inspection tool output.
service_authentication: Socket Mode with separate app-level and bot tokens; deprecated verification token is not configured in the service. Public Slack HTTP ingress is not deployed.
mitigation: Browser output sanitizer expanded before subsequent credential inspections.
Rotation initiated in Slack app settings; Slack requires direct password re-verification.
User asked to authenticate in Slack UI without sending the password in chat.
After owner reauthentication, activated a replacement verification token and verified persistence after reloading app settings on 2026-09-21 KST.
server_operating_tokens: Retained only in private service credential storage; staging file removed after cutover.

rotation_verification.comparison: Browser-local SHA-256 comparison; neither credential values nor hashes were returned or stored in this record. Temporary browser hash removed after verification.
